# README

- **Author**: `蔡睿燊`
- **Created At**: `2026-11-08`
- **Last Modified At**: `2026-11-08`

---

## What does this file do?

- 把已處理好的臺北站（`StationID` = `466920`）天氣資料，依時間解析度各自把 2024 與 2025 兩年**直向合併（row bind）**成一個 Parquet 檔：
  - 逐時：`weather_taipei_2024_hourly.csv` + `weather_taipei_2025_hourly.csv` → `weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet`
  - 每 15 分鐘：`weather_taipei_2024_15min.csv` + `weather_taipei_2025_15min.csv` → `weather_taipei_15min_2024_2025.parquet`
- 觀測單位不變：逐時檔一列為一個整點 `datetime`（區間 (t − 60 分鐘, t]），15 分鐘檔一列為一個 15 分鐘 `datetime`（區間 (t − 15 分鐘, t]）。各欄位的定義與處理規則（測站選擇、`-99`／`-990` 規則、回看門檻、`rain` 定義）完全沿用四個上游 Rmd，本檔**不重新計算、不補值、不改任何數值**。
- 本檔唯一的轉換：
  - `datetime` 從 CSV 的文字（`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`，當地時間）轉為 `Asia/Taipei` 時區的時間戳記（Parquet `timestamp`），讓 R（`POSIXct`）與 Python（`pandas` tz-aware `datetime64`）讀入時直接是時間型態。
  - 欄位型態固定：`Temp`、`HUMD`、`D24R` 為 double，`weather_age_min`、`rain` 為 integer，`D24R_trace` 為 logical。
  - 依 `datetime` 排序。
- 合併前後檢查：兩年欄名一致、`datetime` 不重疊、合併後兩年連續不中斷，且每一列數值與原 CSV 完全相同。
- 跨年邊界：上游各年獨立處理，2025-01-01 00:00 這一格的區間 (2024-12-31 23:00 或 23:45, 00:00] 屬於 2024-12-31 的雨量累積日，但 2025 年程式只讀 2025 年原始檔，`rain` 的起點會預設為 0。若 2024-12-31 有降雨，這一格可能被誤標為 1；下方檢查 2024 年最後一格與 2025 年第一格的 `D24R`，確認此次合併沒有這個問題。
- 原本四個 CSV 保留不動（`PROJECT-PROPOSAL.md` 仍有登記）；Parquet 是之後分析建議讀取的合併版本。

  - Downstream finding input: `data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet`（同一檔案）

  - Verification status / SHA-256: 見最後一個 chunk 的實際輸出與下方「執行結果」。
  - Downstream finding input: `data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_15min_2024_2025.parquet`（同一檔案）

All paths are relative to the project root, not the operating-system root.
讀寫 Parquet 使用 `arrow` 套件（tidyverse 沒有 Parquet 讀寫功能；專案內 YouBike 資料也已用 Parquet 儲存）。

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}

```

```{r}
INPUTS <- c(
  hourly_2024 = "data/processed/weather_taipei_2024_hourly.csv",
  hourly_2025 = "data/processed/weather_taipei_2025_hourly.csv",
  min15_2024 = "data/processed/weather_taipei_2024_15min.csv",
  min15_2025 = "data/processed/weather_taipei_2025_15min.csv"
)
EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256 <- c(
  hourly_2024 = "fe3af4b782fe20a91b602b218150bc33a7bf3436963dca4f8b217d2a7a659fa3",
  hourly_2025 = "48775131d3b4d7af851a2a438327dd23bf0d8947b8ef7f514bd0ce9ad2116619",
  min15_2024 = "6a12d0545fa5dba474ee085d08536b58d74ab012a5cf55347cabb7b48bf8d9d7",
  min15_2025 = "76637e5ee8bbc22748afff69b967e5a4874b2a8701c002452b071c50945b3882"
)
EXPECTED_INPUT_ROWS <- c(hourly_2024 = 8784L, hourly_2025 = 8760L, min15_2024 = 35136L, min15_2025 = 35040L)
OUTPUTS <- c(
  hourly = "data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet",
  min15 = "data/processed/weather/weather_taipei_15min_2024_2025.parquet"
)
# Set to TRUE only when intentionally regenerating these outputs.
ALLOW_REPLACE_OUTPUTS <- FALSE

# Read datetime as text first so the local-time strings are parsed explicitly in Asia/Taipei.
HOURLY_COLUMNS <- c("datetime", "Temp", "HUMD", "D24R", "D24R_trace", "rain")
MIN15_COLUMNS <- c("datetime", "Temp", "HUMD", "weather_age_min", "D24R", "D24R_trace", "rain")
hourly_col_types <- cols(
  datetime = col_character(),
  Temp = col_double(),
  HUMD = col_double(),
  D24R = col_double(),
  D24R_trace = col_logical(),
  rain = col_integer()
)
min15_col_types <- cols(
  datetime = col_character(),
  Temp = col_double(),
  HUMD = col_double(),
  weather_age_min = col_integer(),
  D24R = col_double(),
  D24R_trace = col_logical(),
  rain = col_integer()
)
INPUT_COL_TYPES <- list(
  hourly_2024 = hourly_col_types,
  hourly_2025 = hourly_col_types,
  min15_2024 = min15_col_types,
  min15_2025 = min15_col_types
)

read_weather_csv <- function(path, col_types) {
  result <- read_csv(path, col_types = col_types, na = c("", "NA"))
  stopifnot(nrow(problems(result)) == 0L)
  result
}

input_paths <- vapply(INPUTS, project_file, character(1), area = "processed")
output_paths <- vapply(OUTPUTS, project_file, character(1), area = "processed", must_exist = FALSE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(output_paths), !any(output_paths %in% input_paths))
if (any(file.exists(output_paths)) && !ALLOW_REPLACE_OUTPUTS) {
  stop("Review existing outputs before replacing them (set ALLOW_REPLACE_OUTPUTS <- TRUE to regenerate).")
}
stopifnot(setequal(names(EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256), names(INPUTS)))
input_fingerprints <- vapply(names(input_paths), function(key) {
  verify_input_sha256(input_paths[[key]], EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256[[key]])
}, character(1))

inputs <- map(set_names(names(INPUTS)), function(key) {
  read_weather_csv(input_paths[[key]], INPUT_COL_TYPES[[key]])
})
for (key in names(inputs)) {
  print(list(input = key, data_path = INPUTS[[key]], rows = nrow(inputs[[key]]),
             schema = vapply(inputs[[key]], function(x) paste(class(x), collapse = "/"), character(1)),
             sha256 = input_fingerprints[[key]]))
}
```

## 合併

`datetime` 文字以 `Asia/Taipei` 解析（臺灣無日光節約時間，每個當地時間都唯一對應一個時點），再把同解析度的兩年直向合併並排序。

```{r}
parse_weather_time <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(datetime, tz = "Asia/Taipei"))
}

combine_years <- function(df_2024, df_2025) {
  stopifnot(identical(names(df_2024), names(df_2025)))
  bind_rows(
    parse_weather_time(df_2024),
    parse_weather_time(df_2025)
  ) |>
    arrange(datetime)
}

weather_hourly <- combine_years(inputs$hourly_2024, inputs$hourly_2025)
weather_15min <- combine_years(inputs$min15_2024, inputs$min15_2025)

outputs <- list(hourly = weather_hourly, min15 = weather_15min)
walk(outputs, glimpse)
```

## 合併檢查

```{r}
check_full_grid <- function(df, step, first, last) {
  expected_grid <- seq(
    ymd_hms(first, tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
    ymd_hms(last, tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
    by = step
  )
  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(df$datetime),
    !anyDuplicated(df$datetime),
    nrow(df) == length(expected_grid),
    all(df$datetime == expected_grid)
  )
  tibble(rows = nrow(df), first = min(df$datetime), last = max(df$datetime))
}

# Every combined row must equal the corresponding input row (datetime compared as text).
check_values_unchanged <- function(combined, df_2024, df_2025) {
  original <- bind_rows(df_2024, df_2025)
  as_text <- combined |>
    mutate(datetime = format(datetime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "Asia/Taipei"))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(as_text), as.data.frame(original), check.attributes = FALSE)))
  "數值與原 CSV 完全相同"
}

bind_rows(
  check_full_grid(weather_hourly, "hour", "2024-01-01 00:00:00", "2025-12-31 23:00:00") |>
    mutate(output = "hourly", .before = 1),
  check_full_grid(weather_15min, "15 min", "2024-01-01 00:00:00", "2025-12-31 23:45:00") |>
    mutate(output = "min15", .before = 1)
)
check_values_unchanged(weather_hourly, inputs$hourly_2024, inputs$hourly_2025)
check_values_unchanged(weather_15min, inputs$min15_2024, inputs$min15_2025)
```

### 跨年邊界

2025 年第一格的 `rain` 由 2025 年程式以起點 0 計算。若 2024-12-31 最後的累積雨量 `D24R` 為 0 且 2025-01-01 00:00 的 `D24R` 也為 0，這一格的 `rain` = 0 與跨年連續計算的結果一致。

```{r}
boundary_rows <- bind_rows(
  weather_hourly |>
    filter(between(datetime, ymd_hms("2024-12-31 22:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"), ymd_hms("2025-01-01 01:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"))) |>
    mutate(output = "hourly", .before = 1),
  weather_15min |>
    filter(between(datetime, ymd_hms("2024-12-31 23:30:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"), ymd_hms("2025-01-01 00:15:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"))) |>
    mutate(output = "min15", .before = 1)
)
boundary_rows

first_2025 <- boundary_rows |>
  filter(datetime == ymd_hms("2025-01-01 00:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"))
last_2024 <- boundary_rows |>
  filter(datetime < ymd_hms("2025-01-01 00:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei")) |>
  group_by(output) |>
  slice_max(datetime, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
stopifnot(
  all(last_2024$D24R == 0),
  all(first_2025$D24R == 0),
  all(first_2025$rain == 0L)
)
"跨年邊界：2024-12-31 尾端與 2025-01-01 00:00 的 D24R 皆為 0，第一格 rain = 0 不受分年處理影響"
```

## 寫出與讀回

```{r}
# Run only after the transformation chunk has produced and checked `outputs`.
stopifnot(setequal(names(outputs), names(OUTPUTS)))
for (key in names(outputs)) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(outputs[[key]]), !anyDuplicated(names(outputs[[key]])))
}
verification <- list()
for (key in names(outputs)) {
  path <- output_paths[[key]]
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(path) && !ALLOW_REPLACE_OUTPUTS) stop("Output already exists; review it before replacing: ", path)
  frame <- outputs[[key]]
  write_parquet(frame, path)
  reread <- read_parquet(path)
  stopifnot(
    identical(names(reread), names(frame)),
    nrow(reread) == nrow(frame),
    identical(attr(reread$datetime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei"),
    identical(vapply(reread, function(x) class(x)[1], character(1)), vapply(frame, function(x) class(x)[1], character(1)))
  )
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(frame), as.data.frame(reread), check.attributes = FALSE)))
  fingerprint <- sha256_file(path)
  verification[[key]] <- list(data_path = OUTPUTS[[key]], rows = nrow(reread),
                              schema = vapply(reread, function(x) paste(class(x), collapse = "/"), character(1)),
                              parquet_schema = read_parquet(path, as_data_frame = FALSE)$schema$ToString(),
                              sha256 = fingerprint,
                              status = "read-back checks passed")
  print(verification[[key]])
}
for (key in names(input_paths)) {
  stopifnot(identical(sha256_file(input_paths[[key]]), input_fingerprints[[key]]))
}
```

## 執行結果

2026-11-08 在乾淨 R 程序以 `knitr::knit()` 執行（輸出至暫存 Markdown 檢查），結果如下：

- 四個輸入 CSV 的 SHA-256 皆與 `PROJECT-PROPOSAL.md` 登記值相同；欄名、列數（8,784／8,760／35,136／35,040）與 `datetime` 文字格式皆符合預期，讀檔無 parsing problem。
- 逐時檔：17,544 列 × 6 欄，2024-01-01 00:00 至 2025-12-31 23:00 每小時一列，`datetime` 不重複且連續；每列數值與原 CSV 完全相同。
- 15 分鐘檔：70,176 列 × 7 欄，2024-01-01 00:00 至 2025-12-31 23:45 每 15 分鐘一列，`datetime` 不重複且連續；每列數值與原 CSV 完全相同。
- 跨年邊界：2024-12-31 最後一格與 2025-01-01 00:00 的 `D24R` 皆為 0，2025 年第一格 `rain` = 0，分年處理沒有造成誤標。
- 寫出後重新讀回：欄名、列數、欄位型態（`datetime` 為 `timestamp[us, tz=Asia/Taipei]`、`weather_age_min`／`rain` 為 int32、`D24R_trace` 為 bool）與數值皆與寫出前一致；刪除輸出後重跑一次，兩檔 SHA-256 不變。
  - `weather_taipei_hourly_2024_2025.parquet`：`3d673f5e42f30ece48d514556d8c3c22848533b41c9a44ae543a20243a8e7000`
  - `weather_taipei_15min_2024_2025.parquet`：`574c2d55229125faff1e6ba305187be1900dab1475b4f059a441c7d7aa8574fa`
- 輸入檔在執行前後 SHA-256 不變。
- 再次執行前須把 `ALLOW_REPLACE_OUTPUTS` 改為 `TRUE`，否則會因輸出已存在而停止。
